name: TOB Bible Explanation
description: AI-generated Bible explanation content, cached by (reference, explanation_type, language, prompt_version) so a repeat request doesn't re-call the provider. Deliberately holds no scripture text of its own — `reference` is a plain string (e.g. 'John 3:16') the client already resolves against its own on-device Bible data; this doctype only stores what the AI generated ABOUT that reference, clearly distinct from Scripture itself.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: Plain reference string as the client displays it, e.g. 'John 3:16', 'Romans 8:28-30' — never a foreign key into a server-side verse table.

fields.label: Explanation Type
fields.options:
verse
chapter
passage
book
verse_by_verse
simple
children
youth
academic
key_message
main_ideas
difficult_passage
summary
detailed
contextual
practical_application
reflection_questions

fields.label: Cache Key
fields.description: Computed as reference|explanation_type|language_code|prompt_version at insert time — the lookup key a repeat request checks before calling the AI gateway again.

fields.label: Prompt Version
fields.description: The TOB AI Prompt.version used to generate this — bumping the prompt's version invalidates old cache entries naturally, since the cache_key changes.
